reviews.title: Bad optimization
reviews.text: Please optimize this app for ipad and iphone duo

reviews.title: User Interface needs work
reviews.text: The app needs a lot of work, it is hard to go back from certain pages and the bookmark button has stopped working for quite a while now, I have to exit the app close it completely then come back and be able to bookmark the ayah I left off

reviews.title: Bookmarking
reviews.text: Lately bookmarking is working properly, cannot bookmark surahs even though I don’t have many bookmarks. I have pro version.

reviews.title: Bookmarks don't work
reviews.text: IQURAN is the best Quran app but a week ago or so the Bookmarks started failing. It only works when it's launched, otherwise it won't work. You have to relaunch it

reviews.title: Glitches with tajweed colours
reviews.text: The colour coding on the tajweed has all greyed out
